llm.note: Main model gemini-3.6-flash for now (user's choice, 2026-11-11: gemini-3.8-flash hung or was overloaded several times that day; set it back here). Price kept at 3.8-flash list prices as an upper estimate. Gemini called directly through Google's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Google does not report cost, so it is estimated from price_usd_per_mtok (list price, thinking counted as output); calls on the free tier actually cost $0.

worker_agent.note: The worker's search turns (choosing the next tool call) use this cheaper model; write_cases and the other nodes use the main model (ADR D23). Price from third-party listings, 2026-11-11.

reviewer.note: The independent reviewer (node 8), in a fresh context. gemini-3.6-flash for now (user's choice, 2026-11-11: 3.8-flash was overloaded); price kept at 3.8-flash list prices as an upper estimate. Switch here to try another model (ADR D25).

pool.note: Several SLM hosts (ADR D31, specbridge/slm_pool.py): SLM_BASE_URLS lists them (name=url, comma-separated). jobs_per_host: this process's jobs per host at once (each host runs one at a time). A host is down after down_after_failures failed requests in a row and checked again after retry_down_seconds; healthy hosts are checked every health_seconds.

slm.note: The SLM host (scripts/slm_host.py, ADR D29, docs/DEPLOY_SLM.md): Ollama on a Kaggle GPU (T4 x2) behind a key check and a Cloudflare quick tunnel. SLM_BASE_URL is the address the host prints (base_url is the host run on this laptop with --no-tunnel); SLM_API_KEY is the host's key. Answers are jobs that are polled, so the tunnel's ~100 s limit never applies. The context sizes per model are set by the host (--models); worker_context_cap and evidence_chars keep the worker's prompts inside them. No cost is reported (the GPU is free), so cost_usd is empty.

worker_agent.note: The worker's search turns (many short JSON tool choices): the smaller, faster model of the same family (ADR D23, D29). Host context 20480.

reviewer.note: The independent reviewer: another model family from the writers (ARCHITECTURE.md section 3, ADR D25, D29). All three models fit in a T4 x2 at once, so none is swapped out during a run. Host context 24576.
